permitted_new_claims: For the pinned sequential OSS path, a candidate-derived exact-hash set has at most k distinct existing hashes. Conditional on N distinct-hash facts being re-emitted without additional suppression, at least max(0,N-k) survive this check. The bound is elementary counting, not a new recovery theorem.

The controlled Mem0 parameter sweep tests physical cardinality separately from exact fact-set equality, and intervention arms identify the candidate-bound dependency. These are finite parameter executions, not independent natural model trials.
